placeholders.<REPO>: Root of the gwf3-migration checkout used for the checks. All relative paths resolve from this root.

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
files = ['README.md','docs/operating.md','docs/reference.md','docs/releasing.md','docs/validation/README.md','example/README.md']
errors = []
links = blocks = 0
for name in files:
    path = Path(name)
    text = path.read_text()
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith('mailto:'):
            continue
        filename, _, fragment = target.partition('#')
        dest = path.parent / filename if filename else path
        links += 1
        if not dest.exists():
            errors.append(f'{name}: missing {target}')
        elif fragment and dest.suffix == '.md':
            headings = re.findall(r'^#+\s+(.*)$', dest.read_text(), re.M)
            anchors = [re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in headings]
            if fragment not in anchors:
                errors.append(f'{name}: missing anchor {target}')
    for language, body in re.findall(r'```(\w*)\n(.*?)```', text, re.S):
        if language in {'sh','bash'}:
            blocks += 1
            result = subprocess.run(['bash','-n'], input=body, text=True, capture_output=True)
            if result.returncode:
                errors.append(f'{name}: shell syntax {result.stderr}')
print(f'Checked {links} local links and {blocks} shell code blocks.')
print('\n'.join(errors) if errors else 'All checks passed.')
raise SystemExit(bool(errors))
